messages.subject: navigation bar problem
parts:
Hi,

I finished a course in Coursera called Daveloping Data Products.  I submitted my project in this URL https://docofi.shinyapps.io/ShinyApp10/  It's a shiny app that locates/identifies the rows of misclassified points from an algorithm.  The app worked fine. After the course i tried to improve on it by adding other features like a navigation bar.  The added features worked fine but the main feature of identifying rows from datapoints stopped working.  Here's the URL for the so-called improved version https://docofi.shinyapps.io/ShinyApp16/ I get this error message when i click on the data points recursive indexing failed at level 2.

Another project i submitted was for a capstone project that used a navigation bar.  The main feature, predicting the next word, worked fine but the items in the navigation bar were shown continuously one on top of the other  instead of being accessed one by one clicking on the navigation bar.  Here's the URL https://docofi.shinyapps.io/capstone/  I used the same codes for the navigation bar i used for another shiny project i made and the codes worked fine for that app.  Here's the URL for that app https://docofi.shinyapps.io/ShinyApp15/

Any comments is appreciated.  I didn't include the codes as it is a bit long.

Ed
